payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about various baseline models used in the study, including their configurations and types.

claims.text: The baselines include a vanilla ST baseline, which has only a speech encoder and a decoder.
Pre-training baselines consist of three experiments: encoder pre-training, decoder pre-training, and encoder-decoder pre-training.
Multi-task baselines include one-to-many, many-to-one, and many-to-many settings.
End-to-end baselines are also compared in the experiments.
